`final class KeyResolver`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.input.key.resolver` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [KeyResolver.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/input/key/resolver/KeyResolver.java)

The registry of the key resolvers that turn the bindings of your application into keys for shortcuts.

## Description

A [`Shortcut`](/reference/ui/shortcut/) created from an object that is not a [`Key`](/reference/input/key/) asks this registry which key it stands for.
In dev mode, a shortcut whose binding no resolver knows prints a warning when it is created, and fires once a resolver that knows it is registered.

## Method details

<a id="KeyResolver-method-register"></a>

### register

`void register(IKeyResolver resolver)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Adds a resolver, asked before every resolver registered earlier.
Registering the same resolver again moves it to the front.

<a id="KeyResolver-method-unregister"></a>

### unregister

`void unregister(IKeyResolver resolver)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Removes a resolver; the shortcuts whose binding only it knew stop firing.

<a id="KeyResolver-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(Object binding)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

If `true`, the binding is a [`Key`](/reference/input/key/) or when a registered resolver supports it.

<a id="KeyResolver-method-resolve"></a>

### resolve

`Key resolve(Object binding)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: No key resolver knows the binding … of type …, pass a Key or register an IKeyResolver with KeyResolver.register(...)

Returns the key of a binding: a [`Key`](/reference/input/key/) as it is, any other object through the first resolver that supports it.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` when no resolver supports the binding.
